title: Etale compact-support composition comparison commutes with base change
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and N an EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A. Let U, X, B, Uprime, Xprime and Bprime be Noetherian schemes, u:U→X and uprime:Uprime→Xprime separated etale finite-type maps, and f:X→B a separated finite-type map. Suppose f, fprime:Xprime→Bprime, u f and uprime fprime are compactifiable, with the primed maps quasi-compact. Take Cartesian squares (r,fprime,f,v), (r1,uprime,u,r), and (r1,uprime fprime,u f,v). Write E and Eprime for derived sum extension, F and Fprime for compact support of f and fprime, T and Tprime for compact support of u f and uprime fprime. Let alpha:E⋙F≅T and alphaprime:Eprime⋙Fprime≅Tprime be etaleAmbientLeftComparison for the chosen compactifications. Let xi_f and xi_uf be inverse compact-support exchange, and J:u*⋙r1*≅r*⋙uprime* the canonical inverse-image square. For the exact sum/restriction adjunctions transported to left-derived inverse image, let xi_u be the inverse mate of J.hom. Then for every M in D(U_et,A), xi_uf(M) ≫ v*(alpha.inv(M)) = alphaprime.inv(r1*M) ≫ Fprime(xi_u(M)) ≫ xi_f(E(M)). This uses the scheme and derived-category notation and actual comparisons of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization], [def-asd-smooth-dualizing-base-change-arrows] and [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting].

proof.text: Use the normalization refinement law, the proper-refinement normalization formula, and the compactification comparison cocycle. A common refinement extends the normalization comparison equation to any two compactifications. Inverting it expresses the ambient left comparison as the inverse chosen graph comparison followed by the chosen compact-support compositor.

proof.text: The support-to-direct-image inclusion is monic, by the proper-support range description of open extension. Its normalization equation therefore forces N.sheafComparison to equal the canonical graph comparison; the derived normalization equation and localization faithfulness force equality of their derived comparisons. Compute the right mate of normalized support exchange on the chosen pullback using the support-exchange right-mate theorem. Transport to an arbitrary Cartesian square through its pullback isomorphism, using open-restriction normalization and normalization pasting. For adjunctions transported along the graph comparisons, their conjugate right comparisons are identities. The mate bijection then identifies inverse normalized support exchange conjugated by the graph comparisons with the inverse mate of the exact pullback square.

proof.text: Transport the inverse exact square and its inverse mate to left-derived inverse image using leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. Expand the two canonical pullback compositors, and cancel their comparison isomorphisms. Naturality and the adjunction transport formulas show that this is precisely the inverse mate under the transported adjunctions in the statement. The compact-support comparison theorem identifies chosen normalized support exchange with compact-support base change. Similarly transport the compact-support composition/base-change equation to left-derived inverse image.

proof.text: Invert the compact-support composition/base-change equation. Substitute the chosen-compactification expression for both ambient left comparisons. Naturality moves the inverse exchange for f across the graph comparison for u. Combine the two maps inside compact support for fprime, apply the normalized inverse-mate identity from the preceding steps, and use functoriality and associativity. This is the required component equality.

theorem etaleAmbientLeftComparison_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    {U X B U' X' B' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian B]
    [IsNoetherian U'] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian B']
    (u : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ B) (u' : U' ⟶ X') (f' : X' ⟶ B')
    [Etale u] [IsSeparated u] [LocallyOfFiniteType u] [QuasiCompact u]
    [Etale u'] [IsSeparated u'] [LocallyOfFiniteType u'] [QuasiCompact u']
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f']
    [HasCompactification (u ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (u' ≫ f')]
    [QuasiCompact f'] [QuasiCompact (u' ≫ f')]
    (v : B' ⟶ B) (r : X' ⟶ X) (r₁ : U' ⟶ U)
    (sq : IsPullback r f' f v) (sqU : IsPullback r₁ u' u r)
    (sq₁ : IsPullback r₁ (u' ≫ f') (u ≫ f) v)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A U) :
    letI := isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq
    letI := isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq₁
    (inv (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq₁)).app M ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).leftDerivedFunctor.map
          ((etaleAmbientLeftComparison A N u f
            (HasCompactification.compactification f)
            (HasCompactification.compactification (u ≫ f))).inv.app M) =
      (etaleAmbientLeftComparison A N u' f'
        (HasCompactification.compactification f')
        (HasCompactification.compactification (u' ≫ f'))).inv.app
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r₁).leftDerivedFunctor.obj M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f').map
        (((mateEquiv
          ((derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance).ofNatIsoRight
              (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u).symm)
          ((derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u' inferInstance).ofNatIsoRight
              (leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u').symm)).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
            (((leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r₁ u).symm ≪≫
              leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u' r (r₁ ≫ u)
                sqU.w).hom))).natTrans.app M) ≫
      (inv (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A sq)).app
        ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
